name: drone_takeoff
description: Take the drone off: its props spin up and it climbs to a hover about 0.8 m above where it stands, then holds there by itself. Needs a drone course open (the drone stands at its start). If the course is scored and no run is armed yet, this arms one, so the first flight counts. It is a simulated drone in the room, so no confirmation is needed. Use it when the person says take off, lift off, or fly.

name: drone_land
description: Land the drone straight down onto whatever is under it. With home true it first flies back over where it started and lands there ("come back and land"). Use it when the person says land, come down, come back, or come home.

home.description: True to fly back to the start before landing.

name: drone_stop
description: The drone's safe stop: it lets go of the sticks and of flying home, brakes, and hovers where it is. It does not cut the motors in the air. Use it when the person says stop, hold, hover or wait.

name: drone_reset
description: Put the drone back at the start of the course, landed and whole. Use it after a crash, or when the person asks to start over. A run in progress is dropped.

name: drone_status
description: Read the drone: its state (landed, taking_off, flying, landing, crashed), height above the floor, speed, distance from the start, whether it is flying home, how many times it bumped something, and the run's state on the open course. Says so when there is no drone.

name: drone_follow
description: Follow-me: the drone keeps a set distance from the person's headset (on the side it is on, so it trails them as they walk), at a set height, turned to face them, steering round the scanned walls and furniture. It takes off first if it is on the ground. Any stick, Stop or Land ends it; it holds in place if the person comes within 0.8 m or there is no free spot, and stops following if the room scan goes away. Needs the room scan on the headset. Use it when the person says follow me, come with me, or track me.

distance_m.description: Distance to keep from the person, metres (1 to 4, default 2).

height_m.description: Height above the floor to fly at, metres (0.5 up to the ceiling less 0.35). Leave out for just under head height.

name: drone_follow_stop
description: Stop following: the drone brakes and hovers where it is. Use it when the person says stop following, stay, or stay there.

name: drone_cam
description: Show or hide the drone cam: a small window with the view from a camera on the drone's nose and its true telemetry (distance to the person, altitude, speed, mode). It is the drone's VIRTUAL view: the virtual scene plus the room scan drawn as lines and an orange box at the person's headset position (known from the headset, not detected in the image). Passthrough is not in it. Use it when the person asks to see what the drone sees.

on.description: True to show (default), false to hide.
